title: Join a cluster as a worker
intro: This machine joins an existing cluster and runs workloads. You need the server's address and its join token (run 'sudo nodeyard token' on the server).
success: This machine has joined the cluster.

steps.label: Server address
steps.help: The cluster's API address: https://ADDRESS:6443 (use the virtual IP if your cluster has one).

steps.label: Join token (shown by 'sudo nodeyard token --reveal' on the server)
Which network interface should cluster traffic use?

options.label: Automatic (the one that routes to the server)

steps.label: k3s version (leave empty for the stable release)
steps.help: Use the same version as the servers (shown by 'nodeyard status' there). A worker must never be newer than the servers.
